# Zodiac

> A firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 synth: twelve signs of the zodiac, each a moving picture and a piece of ambient music that composes itself as it goes. By Stephen Cummins.

- There is nothing to learn before it makes music. After 30 minutes of playing, the next sign takes over.
- The bottom left button sets off the sign's own event, in the music and the picture together.
- Four knobs: low pass, high pass, echo and reverb. The lower buttons are effects, each for as long as it is held.
- No hardware is needed to try it: there is an emulator in the browser.
- It replaces the firmware on the FM-1 while installed. It is an early version, offered with no warranty. The install page also puts M-VAVE's own firmware back.
- GPL-3.0, built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, which come from Felucca. Not made by or connected with M-VAVE.

## Pages

- [Zodiac](https://zodiac.stephen8n.com/): the twelve signs and how to install
- [Controls](https://zodiac.stephen8n.com/controls/): every knob and button, drawn
- [Emulator](https://zodiac.stephen8n.com/emu/): Zodiac in the browser, with sound
- [Install](https://zodiac.stephen8n.com/install/): from Chrome or Edge on a computer, over USB

## Source

- [fm1-zodiac](https://github.com/stephencummins/fm1-zodiac)
